balls.text: low full toss on the legs at 147 kph, flicked to deep backward square leg for one, poor relay is way wide of the keeper despite Shahbaz being well short of the crease coming back for the second and it allows them to get the two in the end.
full and sailing down the leg side at 141 kph, misses a flick. Rawat wasn't really taking a start at the non-striker's end on the would-be final ball so they don't swap strike.
attempted yorker comes in as a shin high full toss at 148 kph on the pads, flicks this to deep fine leg for one.
147 kph yorker skids in between the legs of Shahbaz clearing the front leg for a heave, fumbled by the keeper and they pinch a bye.
yorker speared into the legs at 149 kph, scuffs this out into the leg side for one.
slower length ball on fifth stump, pulled along the ground through midwicket for one.
low full toss at shin height at 147 kph on off stump, flicked through midwicket for one.
yorker on sixth stump, scuffs this out to deep midwicket for one.
he finally lands one on the pitch! After four straight full tosses, a full length ball on fifth stump is heaved to wide midwicket for one.
knee high full toss on leg stump, gets on a knee to sweep/pull this behind square to the rope.
knee high full toss on sixth stump at 134 kph, another miscued heave to long-on for one.
another misfired yorker at 136 kph comes in at knee height on off stump, Shahbaz flubs a drive that dribbles to long-on for one.
goes for wide yorker at 135 kph but instead it's a shin high full toss on seventh stump that is pumped through extra cover to the rope.
slower 127 kph length ball on middle, clears the front leg and heaves this over midwicket to the rope.
139 kph bouncer on fifth stump, left alone and deemed legal on height.
148 kph delivery lands on a good length on the body again, another miscued heave deflects behind square leg and they scamper a tight two.
length ball on the hips, goes to pull and deflects off the body to the keeper for none.
143 kph delivery back of a length on the hips, goes back to flick to deep fine leg for one.
length ball on fifth stump, miscues a drive to extra cover for one.
reaches out to convert this into a low full toss on leg stump sweeping this firmly to the deep backward square leg rope.
full on the stumps, clipped through wide long-on for one.
full on fourth stump, prods this gently into cover for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, sliced to deep point for one.
good length ball on fifth stump, guided to short third for none.
good length ball on fifth stump, guided to backward point for none.
thigh high full toss on middle, tapped gently to deep midwicket for one. RCB's current batting mindset showing on that ball. They have gone far into a shell.
back of a length follows him backing away from leg, flicked into midwicket for one.
full and sliding down leg, goes to sweep and misses. Wide called.
back of a length on fourth stump, gets on a knee to pull to wide midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, punched to midwicket for none.
good length ball on fifth stump, guided to short third for none.
short on seventh stump, sliced to the point sweeper for one.
full on seventh stump, miscues a drive back to the bowler.
good length ball on the legs, goes across to flick and clips the thigh guard past the keeper and splits leg slip for two extras.
good length ball defended.

good length ball on off, prods forward and inside edges this to leg slip on one bounce. Warner dives to stop this and flicks this to the keeper all in one motion to nearly effect a runout as Rawat drifted forward looking for a run.

googly again landing on off stump and spins away, Dinesh Karthik tries to swat this flat over midwicket but doesn't get under it enough and it carries to the man charging in off the rope sliding on his knees taking a sharp catch at thigh height, Lalit Yadav.

flights this full outside leg stump, Maxwell clears the front leg to slay this over midwicket but it spins away toward off and produces a top edge swirling over extra cover. Warner backpedals from the ring and takes this reaching up in front of his face before pumping his fists wildly.

wild heave to a good length ball on fourth stump, Harshal misses and loses his balance. Porel whips the bails off and runs off celebrating. He's certain this is out and it goes to the third umpire. Bizarrely this has been given out caught behind by Michael Gough on what was originally a stumping appeal. There are a bunch of random spikes on UltraEdge both before and after the ball passes the bat, in addition to a similar one as the ball is crossing the bat. There didn't seem to be any genuine differentiation between the sound waves registered through the entire sequence but the third umpire Gough felt there was enough evidence to give it out. This will be a talking point for sure...
full on off stump, Harshal winds up and muscles this 84 meters over long-on deep into the stands.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to the leg side for one.
good length ball on middle, keeps very low underneath a pull shot and hits him in the top of the pads, no real lbw shout from Axar but based on how low it kept, surprising he didn't go for a review.
Axar errs too full on fourth stump, Maxwell reaches out and cranks this over long-on landing 15 rows back.
good length ball speared into the legs, Maxwell can't flick it away.
back of a length on off, tap and run into midwicket for one.
slower ball full on the legs, misses a flick off the pads and it trickles away for a leg bye.
back of a length on fifth stump, defended to cover for none.

fullish length angled across the wide guideline, Lomror goes to drive and there's a definite noise as it passes the bat on the way to the keeper. Marsh appeals wildly but it is given not out. The keeper Porel doesn't really appeal. But Marsh sells his countryman Warner on using a review. Sure enough on UltraEdge, there's a clear spike. Decision overturned.  Porel is getting stick from his teammates now wondering what was he listening to that he couldn't hear the nick.

slower length ball on middle at 119 kph, pulls this off a top-edge that swirls over deep backward square leg and barely clears the fielder Nortje leaping up trying to save this. It's a 62-meter six. Just enough.
good length ball on off, tapped to long-on for one.
fullish length ball on middle and leg, flicked to deep square leg for one.
back of a length on fourth stump at 131 kph, flicked into mid-on for one.
full on fifth stump, Maxwell clears the front leg for a booming heave but misses the free hit.

neck high full toss at 142 kph, Lomror is barely able to get bat on this in self-defense avoiding a catastrophic injury and it comes off a top edge swirling over short third for one. No ball called on height and Nortje wraps his arms around him on the way to the non-striker's end to apologize.
slower back of a length ball on fifth stump at 125 kph, Lomror flails way too early at this as it passes him and bounces a second time before reaching the keeper.
good length ball on middle, flicked to long-on for one.
good length ball on off at 141 kph, flicked into midwicket for one.
flighted full on sixth stump, Maxwell winds up and tees off with a three-wood driving this straight down the fairway landing over the rope at long-on.
shin high full toss on fifth stump, slapped straight to extra cover for none.

ka-boom! Lands on the awning of the second tier! Full on fifth stump, Maxwell winds up and annihilates this over wide long-on. The ball is stuck on the awning out of the reach of the fans in the front row of the second tier and so a replacement ball has to be brought out by the third umpire. Warner is a little unhappy and wants the ball to be retrieved but the umpires say differently.
good length ball on middle, flicked to long-on for one.
full on the legs, flicked through to deep midwicket for one.

of all the balls to get Kohli out.... it's a thigh high full toss! Kohli's eyes bulge out of their sockets as he tries to slaughter this over wide midwicket, but winds up splicing this a mile high before gravity pulls it back to earth into the hands of the fielder standing a yard inside the rope taking this at chest height.
some kind of shot over point! Width on seventh stump on a good length at 135 kph, Lomror hops on his toes to flay this square over the off side rope into the third row.
yorker on middle, chipped through midwicket. Kohli slams his chest to celebrate a 33-ball half-century. It's his 47th IPL fifty to go along with 5 IPL centuries.
114 slower length ball on the hips, Kohli just stands flat-footed and flicks this over backward square leg screaming over the rope landing just over the photographers.
back of a length on off stump, tap and run behind point for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, tap and run into mid-off for one.
full slower ball at 116 kph on fourth stump, Kohli keeps the hands back and creams a drive past Lomror and beats the long-off fielder's diving effort at the rope.
shuffles down the track again and flicks to long-on for one.
fullish length on fifth stump, goes to slog this and a top edge swirls over the keeper for one.

dropped! Return chance shelled! Kohli shuffles down the pitch and punches this uppishly back to Kuldeep, it carries to him at ankle height reaching low across his left leg but it bursts through and trickles to mid-off for one.
length ball on middle, heaves this flat to deep square leg for one.
full on fifth stump, charges and slaps this to long-on for one.
length ball on fifth stump, slapped through extra cover and beats wide long-off to the rope.
low full toss on the stumps, slapped to long-on for one.
length ball on the wide guideline, slapped to wide long-off for one.
full on the legs, flicked to long-on for one.
good length ball on the legs, miscues a flick into fine leg for one.
full on middle, flicked through wide long-on for one.
knee high full toss on fourth stump, slapped to long-on for one.
good length on middle and leg, heaves this to deep midwicket for one.
length ball on seventh stump, backs away to cut and slices a thick edge high and wide of short third backspinning away to the rope.
good length ball on the stumps, slapped back to Kuldeep for none.
full on fourth stump, sweeps a bottom edge to fine leg for one.
good length ball on middle, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
full on middle, smashes an inside edge off his feet into midwicket for none.
charges a full ball on fifth stump, tapped wide of mid-off in the ring for one.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to the midwicket sweeper for one.
full on the stumps, flicked to long-on for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, tapped into the covers for none.
good length ball on the legs, flicked wide of mid-on for one.
good length ball on off, defended.
good length ball on middle, punched back down the pitch toward the non-striker but mid-on charges in to deny the single.

dropped! Manish Pandey shells this at backward point. Almost identical chance to the one Aman Khan just pouched a ball earlier. Fullish delivery on fifth stump, drives hard and it is sliced to Pandey's right on the off side ring. He reaches across his waist two-handed but it bursts out.

sensational catch at midwicket!  A hush comes over the crowd. Length ball on off stump, Faf whips this toward midwicket and Aman Khan leaps stabbing his right hand out and latches on initially before it pops up out of his hands but he keeps his cool to corral it on the second attempt while stumbling sideways.
length ball on fifth stump at 127 kph, Faf muscles this baseball style over the bowler to the mid-off rope.
good length ball on the stumps, tap and run into the ring for a quick single.
fullish length ball on fifth stump, punched on the up charging down the pitch first ball and gets it wide of mid-off to the rope.
good length ball defended.
charges down the wicket to another flat skiddy delivery at 100 kph on middle and shovels a drive high over long-on sailing 10 rows back.
stands flat in his crease and swats a good length ball on middle straight to square leg for none.
short on the legs, goes to pull and misses off the pads for none.
good length ball follows Faf backing away from leg stump, flicks this straight to mid-on for none.
good length ball on middle, flicked into midwicket for one.
low full toss on the knees at 137 kph, charges down the wicket and winds up hustling himself trying to flick this eventually miscuing it back to the bowler.
full on leg stump, charges and heaves this off an inside edge through square leg for one.
full on the stumps, flicked through square leg for one.
137 kph delivery lands full on off, Faf shuffles down the track while backing away from the stumps and smokes a drive flat past Kohli to the mid-off rope.
charges a 139 kph delivery dragged back of a length and Faf top-edges a pull over the keeper to the third man rope.
slower ball to start angled across fifth stump on a good length, Faf is too early pushing at this and is beaten.
full on the legs, flicked in the air well short of deep midwicket for one.
full on middle and leg, defended to extra cover.
full on fourth stump, punched to long-off for one.
full on fifth stump, punched to cover for none.
full on middle and leg, whipped flat through square leg and a sliding stop on the rope keeps this to two.
full on fifth stump, driven firmly to long-off for one.
151 kph yorker on middle, jammed out into midwicket and they get a single out of it.
back of a length on fourth stump, tap and run with soft hands into midwicket for one.
good length slower ball on off stump, blocked into the covers for none.
another good length ball wider on seventh stump, Kohli again laces this on the up squarer over cover and sails to the rope.
good length ball on fifth stump, Kohli trusts the bounce and punches this on the up flying flat over the gap between extra cover and mid-off to the rope.
tighter to the stumps this time on a fullish length, punched to extra cover for none.
sprays this wide outside the guideline on a full length. First run on the board is an extra.
116 kph length ball over middle stump, Kuldeep heaves for midwicket and misses. RCB coast to victory by 23 runs.
good length ball lands well outside the guidelines, left alone and wide called.
knee high full toss on middle, swatted over midwicket, one bounce over the rope.
120 kph fullish length slower ball on sixth stump, checks his shot and it balloons high over extra cover for two.
119 kph slower ball yorker on sixth stump, jammed out to Harshal for none.
knee high full toss on middle at 137 kph, punched to long-on for one.
short on sixth stump, charges and pulls this flat through wide long-on to the rope.
short on the body, pulled to deep square leg for one.
full and speared into the pads again, late on a flick and comes off the pads back to Parnell again.
yorker speared into the legs outside leg stump at 135 kph, misses a flick and the carom off the pads goes back to Parnell collecting at silly mid-off for none in his follow-through.
129 kph short on the body, pulled in the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket to the rope.
118 kph length ball on eighth stump, slapped high over extra cover, one bounce over the rope.
good length ball on fourth stump, goes to cut and an inside edge goes to fine leg for one.
knee high full toss at 140 kph on an attempted yorker is pushed tamely to long-on for one.
full on leg stump, flicked through deep square leg for one.
good length ball angled across fifth stump, Kuldeep pushes at this and misses.

length ball on fifth stump, swats this 133 kph delivery to wide long-on. Kohli shuffles across the rope and pouches this ever so casually at chest height a yard inside the rope akin to an NFL receiver toe-tapping inside the sideline.
good length ball wider on sixth stump, intentionally guided to deep third for a single.
length ball on fifth stump at 140 kph, slices at this flat-footed and a thick edge goes wide of DK behind the stumps to the third man rope.
117 kph slower ball comes in as a knee high full toss on fourth stump, slapped to long-on for one.
goes for a slower yorker and sends down a knee high full toss on fifth stump at 119 kph, driven to long-on for one.
full and wide at 138 kph, scuffs a drive out wide of the cover sweeper for two.
full slower ball lands outside the guidelines, wide called.
123 kph delivery lands full and just inside the wide guideline, goes to punch this over wide extra cover and splits the boundary riders to the rope.
wide yorker on the guideline, jammed out wide of the point sweeper for two.
yorker on sixth stump, sliced behind point for one.
138 kph back of a length on fifth stump, sliced to deep backward point for one.

another slower ball strike for Vyshak! This time at 112 kph on a fullish length on the wide guideline, Yadav swats at this and sends a flat chance to Maxwell 10 yards inside the rope at wide long-off and he takes it casually at rib height.
full on fourth stump, goes to drive and an inside edge goes off the pads trickling wide of the stumps for none.
fullish length slower ball on fifth stump, pushed into extra cover for one.
slower bouncer on the wide guideline, left alone and deemed legal on the line.
slower ball lands full on the wide guideline, reaches out to sweep this through square leg for two.
back of a length on sixth stump, slapped through cover for one.
short on the stumps, pulled to deep square leg for one.
back of a length on middle, defended back to Parnell.
short on the body, pulls this effortlessly over backward square leg and sails flat over the rope.
good length ball flicked away for one.
good length ball on fourth stump at 131 kph, flicked through midwicket for one.

googly spins in from fourth stump into the pads on middle and leg stump beating Pandey playing back. Big lbw appeal from Hasaranga, who is desperate for something to go his way today. Given not out. Not much support on the appeal from the keeper DK who is preoccupied chasing after the ball off the pads deflecting into cover. But it's DK who eventually signals to Faf to call for a review.  Was it high, and was it spinning down leg? Nope! It was straight enough taking out the top of leg stump below the bails. Three reds light up on ball-tracking. Decision overturned.
good length ball on the legs, flicked into vacant midwicket for a tightly run two to bring up a 37-ball half-century. His 22th career IPL fifty, to go along with one IPL century.
short outside leg, shuffles across his stumps and flicks a pull fine of short fine leg to the rope.
fullish length on seventh stump, charges and slaughters this high and wide over wide long-on landing in the 15th row.
full on middle, charges and drives this firmly over the non-striker to the long-on rope.
good length ball on the stumps, comes down the track and taps this back to the bowler.
full on fifth stump, driven to long-on for one.
118 kph slower ball lands full and wide outside off, swings over the top of this as it cuts inside the wide guideline for a dot.
short ball on fifth stump, slices this to short third man for one.
136 kph ball lands short on fourth stump, pulled to deep fine leg where Harshal slides along the rope to keep this to one.
knuckle slower ball lands full on fifth stump, miscues a drive skying this high over extra cover in the ring. Siraj backpedals and gets his hands up to take this in front of his face.
length ball on sixth stump at 143 kph, spanks this flat over mid-off and skids to the rope on two bounces.
full on off, whipped to wide midwicket for a single before Maxwell rifles in a relay.
134 kph full on middle, flicked to deep square leg for one.
135 kph bouncer sails down the leg side, wide called on the line.
full on the legs, flicked to deep backward square leg for one.
full on middle, jammed out back to Harshal.
length ball on sixth stump at 137 kph, slapped to long-off for one.
full on fifth stump at 135 kph, flicked to long-on for one.
short on leg stump, pulls this to deep midwicket for one.
floated full on seventh stump, carves a drive over wide extra cover, one bounce over the rope.
full on fourth stump, flicked to long-on for one.
short on middle, pulls this flat toward Kohli at deep midwicket. He charges in off the rope initially before pulling up and letting it short hop him for one.
short on off, pulled in between deep square leg and deep midwicket to the rope.
length ball on off, pulls this to wide midwicket diving stop by Kohli along the rope keeps this to two.
133 kph length ball on leg stump, goes to flick and an inside edge into the pads caroms to cover for one.
length ball on seventh stump, chopped to the cover sweeper for one.
length ball on sixth stump, slapped to the cover sweeper for one.
short ball on fifth stump, Pandey takes a step down the track and swats this to wide long-on for a long single. Diving stop to keep it to one.
bouncer over leg stump at 136 kph, Pandey ducks under this to leave.
good length ball angled into off, inside edges this into the pads before trickling to Vyshak.
140 kph delivery full on sixth stump, punched to cover for none.

slower ball comes in at 120 kph as a thigh high full toss on off stump, Porel is flummoxed by this and miscues a toe-slap aiming for midwicket but it pops up gently to mid-on. Parnell takes a simple catch at head height 10 yards behind the circle.
back of a length angled tighter across fourth stump at 135 kph, beats him trying to punch this through cover off the back foot.
length ball angled across fifth stump, sliced to backward point for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, tap and run into long-on for one.
good length on fourth stump, Porel opens the face to guide this behind point for one.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.
short on fourth stump, flicked through the leg side for one.
googly spins on a good length in toward middle, flicked through midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, tapped behind point for another dot.
short and wide, slapped to backward point for none.
drag down to start on middle, pulled through wide long-on to the rope.
back of a length on the stumps, tapped off the back foot into midwicket for one.
full on sixth stump, punched through cover to the sweeper for one.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
short on the stumps, pulled through backward square leg to the rope.
good length ball on the stumps, punched to long-on for one.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through midwicket for a very tight three. Great running for the third and a diving effort beats the relay to the keeper.
back of a length on the stumps, tapped away into square leg for one.
length ball at 134 kph angled across fourth stump, Porel checks his shot halfway into a flick through midwicket and a leading edge balloons high over mid-off clearing the fielder for a nervy run.

maiden IPL wicket for Vyshak! Slower ball at 121 kph angled across fourth stump forces Warner into a miscued pull off the toe straight to Kohli at midwicket on the ring taken at thigh height jogging forward.
142 kph back of a length on the hips, flicked through deep backward square leg to the rope.
short ball on fourth stump, Warner misses out on a pull shot attacking this 138 kph delivery.
back of a length on fifth stump, tapped into the covers for one.
hat-trick of fours and this is the best of the bunch! Good length ball on fourth stump at 138 kph, punched on the up through extra cover to the rope.
140 kph short ball lands well outside leg, Warner swivels to pull this dragging a bottom edge to the fine leg rope.
140 kph length ball on middle, Warner crunches a pull over midwicket, one bounce over the rope.
good length ball on middle, defended to cover.
back of a length on fourth stump, opens the face to tap and run to third man for one.
135 kph back of a length on sixth stump, defended to cover.
back of a length on fifth stump, tap and run into the covers for one.
128 kph full on fourth stump, charges and slams this flat over mid-off, one bounce over the rope.
good length on off stump, sliced to deep point for one.
back of a length on off, flicked into midwicket for one.
back of a length angled across fifth stump, Pandey steps down the track and checks a shot that floats off a leading edge just short and wide of Kohli at short extra cover.
full on fourth stump, goes to drive and a thick inside edge goes to square leg for one.
back of a length on the hips at 143 kph, flicked to deep backward square leg for two to spoil a would-be wicket-maiden. Sensational opening burst from Siraj.
bouncer on middle, Pandey was coming down the pitch to this 143 kph delivery and has to turtle his head away late.
good length ball on fifth stump, defended back to Siraj.
gem! 142 kph delivery seams in sharply from fifth stump to beat Pandey between bat and pad poking at this.

fullish length ball on middle and off at 142 kph, beats him for pace going to drive and a huge lbw shout is upheld. Dhull reviews this with the clock running out. He's hit well below the knee roll though. This is stone dead. Sure enough ball-tracking shows three reds, the ball taking out leg stump three-quarters of the way up.

length ball speared into middle and off stump at 145 kph, misses a flick across the line, big lbw shout denied. Looked a touch high live and after a chat Faf decides not to review. Wisely as replays show an inside edge onto the pads.
back of a length on sixth stump, tapped into the covers for one.
full on fourth stump at 140 kph, punched to mid-off for none.

139 kph length ball on leg stump, Marsh goes to swat this over the leg side. But it climbs on him and a top/leading edge swirls over cover. Kohli is on the ring and doesn't have to move. Kohli calls off the point fielder and takes it reaching in front of his body at waist height.
good length swinging into off stump at 140 kph, defended to cover.
back of a length angled across fifth stump, Marsh shapes to play before pulling the bat back late to leave.
good length on sixth stump, Marsh leaves this alone.
117 kph bouncer over off stump, left alone. Warner wants a wide called that isn't coming and he keeps his reviews in his pocket for now.
back of a length on the body, defended to midwicket.

Shaw's horror run continues and he only has himself to blame running himself out at extra cover. Impact Sub meets Impact Sub as Rawat is the one to make this brilliant fielding effort.  Full on fifth stump, tap and run by Shaw thinking he's placed this wide enough of the fielder but Rawat sprawls out with a diving effort to stop it going to his right, then leaps back onto his feet and flings at the stumps with one stump to aim at from 12 yards away and connects with Shaw two yards short.
back of a length on middle, defended to midwicket for none.
142 kph delivery back of a length on the legs, clipped through midwicket for one.
back of a length on middle at 137 kph, defended to cover.
